verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Pipedream publishes a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) that an agent can be pointed at, so the product itself provides the capability. However, the file's visible content is scoped to the Pipedream Connect app marketplace, and nothing shows it covers the broader workflow, CLI or REST docs, or that agent-oriented markdown docs exist. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt covers the full documentation set (workflows, CLI, REST API), an llms-full.txt or markdown/agent-oriented doc variants, first-party documentation describing the agent-docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://pipedream.com/llms.txt # Pipedream Connect — App marketplace
